highlights: 【Multifunctional Touch Screen】 Ugreen EchoBuds Magic features a LCD touch screen on the charging case. You can set any photo, such as a picture of your pet or your favorite celebrity, as the charging case wallpaper. You can also switch music, increase/decrease music volume, customize sound effects, and display lyrics on it. What's more, the case has the function of taking photos and switching videos.

【ANC & Dual-mic Clear Call】The in-ear eraphone uses advanced noise cancellation technology, maintaining your focus with active noise cancellation. Each earphone is equipped with two noise-canceling MEMS microphones, which can respectively identify and feed back the noise inside and outside the ear to the earphones, thus achieving a stronger noise reduction effect.

【Ultra Long 30h Battery Life & Quick Charging】The playtime of a single earbud can last for 6 hours; the whole playtime lasts for 30 hours when used with the charging case. The excellent earphones can be fully charged in 1.5 hours, and the charging case can be fully charged in 2 hours. Charge the wireless Bluetooth earbuds for 10 minutes, and you can listen to music for 2 hours!

【Hi-res Certified & LDAC】UGREEN EchoBuds Magic supports high-quality audio up to 48kHz/24bit, and is equipped with a 10mm composite biological diaphragm unit, which provides clearer, more accurate sound, reproduce thumping bass and crisp treble.

【Water Resistant & Fit for Outdoor】The in ear buds support IPX5 Waterproof. When you exercise, this headset will not be affected by sweat, which allows you to enjoy wonderful music while exercising. This noise cancellation headset is suitable for wearing on various occasions: during study, work, business trips, exercising, enjoying music alone, or sharing with others.
【What You Get】1 * UGREEN EchoBuds Magic, 1 * user manual,
